entities.summary: Kim Lammers is a Dutch field hockey player who plays as a striker for Dutch club Laren and the Netherlands national team. She was part of the Dutch squad that became world champions at the 2006 Women's Hockey World Cup and won the gold medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics.
